A lower substrate concentration (S=0.5) ensures a low S:cat ratio, making the kinetics highly sensitive to the distribution between free catalyst (`cat`) and the catalyst-substrate complex (`catS`). This will highlight differences between mechanisms that act specifically on `cat` versus `catS`, as both species will be present in significant and comparable amounts during the reaction.
</hypothesis>
